name: PaRuX Virtual Context deterministic recall corpus
description: Synthetic persisted histories. Acceptance checks the Core-selected context pack before any model judgement, so retrieval regressions cannot be hidden by a lucky completion.

cases.constraint: Decision for ATLAS-128: the frame checksum MUST remain CRC32C and the acceptance marker is PARUX_VCTX_128K_CRC32C.
cases.question: For ATLAS-128, what checksum and acceptance marker did we decide?

cases.constraint: Hard requirement for BOREAL-256: runtime inference MUST remain offline-only; preserve marker PARUX_VCTX_256K_OFFLINE_ONLY.
cases.question: Recall the BOREAL-256 runtime requirement and its exact marker.

cases.constraint: Release decision for COSMOS-1M: NEVER rewrite signed migration history; exact marker PARUX_VCTX_1M_NEVER_REWRITE_HISTORY.
cases.question: What old COSMOS-1M release decision must still be respected? Include the exact marker.
